idea-plugin.name: T3 Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
Navigation for TYPO3 (v12+) projects in both directions: from a Fluid template to its partials, layouts, sections and Fluid Components - and from a partial, component or PHP class back to everything that uses it.

Fluid

  • Partials, layouts and sections: Cmd/Ctrl-click partial="Some/Partial", <f:layout name="…"/> or section="…" (tag and inline syntax). Root paths from TypoScript (partialRootPaths …) are included. Partials and layouts that cannot be found are marked as errors.
  • Fluid Components (fluid_components): completion of component tags (prefixes as you type, <my: lists all components of the namespace and inserts the required parameters), Cmd/Ctrl-click a component tag like <my:molecule.teaser>, parameter completion from <fc:param> with type and required/optional, warning for missing required parameters. Unknown components are marked as errors. Gutter icon and Navigate | Related Symbol lead to the component files (.fixture.json, Styles, Scripts …). Namespaces registered in ext_localconf.php are resolved.
  • Usages in the gutter: partials, layouts, templates and components show where they are used - in other templates, partials and TypoScript (EXT: paths, templateName).
  • ViewHelpers: Cmd/Ctrl-click <f:format.html>, {f:count()} or {x -> my:thing()} to open the ViewHelper class, and an attribute or inline argument to jump to its registerArgument(). Namespaces from {namespace}/xmlns, TYPO3 defaults, ext_localconf.php and your own list in Settings | Languages & Frameworks | T3 Toolkit.
  • ViewHelper completion: tags (<f:fo → f:format.html, required arguments inserted) and arguments from registerArgument() with type and description; missing required arguments are marked. Hover a ViewHelper or argument for its documentation.
  • Completion of partial, layout and section names in partial="…", <f:layout name="…"/> and section="…".
  • Icons: Cmd/Ctrl-click and completion for <core:icon identifier="…"/> from Configuration/Icons.php.
  • Variables: Cmd/Ctrl-click {item.title} to jump to where it comes from - f:for as, f:variable, f:alias in the same file, <fc:param> in a component, the f:render arguments that pass it to a partial, or TypoScript (as =, variables.) and PHP (assign(), assignMultiple(), $processedData[]) for templates.
  • EXT: paths are clickable in every file.
  • No more Unresolved file reference for Fluid expressions like href="{f:uri.typolink(…)}".

Labels (XLIFF)

  • Cmd/Ctrl-click LLL:EXT:my_ext/Resources/Private/Language/locallang.xlf:some.key in any file (Fluid, PHP, TCA, TypoScript, YAML, FlexForms) to jump to the <trans-unit>, or the path to open the file. Short keys in <f:translate key="…"/> use the locallang.xlf of extensionName or of the template's extension; also any own translate ViewHelper, LocalizationUtility::translate() and your own ViewHelpers, methods and functions from the settings.
  • Completion of language files after LLL: and of keys (with their text) after .xlf: and in f:translate.
  • Labels are folded in the editor and show their text (click to expand).
  • Missing language files and keys are marked as errors, with a quick-fix Create label that adds the <trans-unit>.
  • In language files: labels missing in a translation (de.locallang.xlf …) or left over in one are marked.
  • Each <trans-unit> shows in the gutter where the label is used.
  • Hover a label to see all its translations; Rename (Shift+F6) changes the key in every language file and usage.

Services.yaml

  • Cmd/Ctrl-click classes, @service references, resource/exclude paths and tag methods.
  • PHP classes show in the gutter in which Services.yaml they are registered and how: service with public/tags/arguments, alias, injected into another service, or autodiscovered via resource.
  • Move to PHP attribute (quick-fix): event.listener, console.command, messenger.message_handler and backend.controller tags become #[AsEventListener], #[AsCommand], #[AsMessageHandler] or #[AsController] on the class, the YAML entry is removed. Only offered where the project's TYPO3 version supports the attribute (from composer.lock).

New classes

New | TYPO3 in a PSR-4 folder: event listener, console command, message handler, backend controller, public service and middleware, registered with PHP attributes - or in Services.yaml where the TYPO3 version needs it (e.g. event listeners on v12). Middlewares are added to Configuration/RequestMiddlewares.php. In a components folder: New | TYPO3 | Fluid Component with a parameter table (name, type, optional) and fixture.

Works alongside other TYPO3 plugins. TYPO3 is a registered trademark of the TYPO3 Association; this plugin is not affiliated with it.
